issues_detected.title: Water Damage on Cabinet Base
issues_detected.description: The cabinet base shows significant water staining and potential mold growth, indicating a past or current leak from the plumbing above.
issues_detected.recommendation: Inspect plumbing for leaks and repair as necessary. Replace or treat the damaged cabinet base to prevent mold growth.

analysis.overall_assessment: The under-sink area shows signs of water damage, likely due to plumbing issues. Immediate inspection and repair are recommended.
